notes: Jank is Arcbond routing, Gideon's Sacrifice, Vindicator prevention, Donna Noble soulbond, and legendary Dawnsire copies, not a linear Osgir rock deck. Fun is choosing which artifact to exile and when to feed a reflector. Mean is a telegraphed wipe, not a lock. Identity: almost every payoff is an artifact Osgir can double; the reflectors are the actual closer.
